risk_bands_note: HEURISTIC bands, not independently validated categories: High = calibrated p >= the cost-based decision threshold; Low = p < 0.50 x that threshold (an arbitrary factor); Medium = in between. Observed default rates per band are reported descriptively; the cut-offs were not optimised or tested for stability.
missing_value_policy: required inputs must be present (training excluded loans lacking them; inference raises). Optional numeric inputs may be missing in both (LightGBM native NaN / MLP train-median + missing flag); missing or unseen categories map to '__other__' in both.
scope: US unsecured 36-month LendingClub loans, 2009-2015 vintages. Prototype.
